title: HSK 3.10 · 前进, 进步, 足够, 制造, 全面
focus: 输 · 充满 · 皮 · 增加 · 期 · 姑娘 · 创造 · 麻烦 · 武器 · 思想 · 害怕 · 龙 · 满足 · 等待 · 乐 · 超级 · 猪 · 团 · 世纪 · 制造 · 足够 · 前面 · 制作 · 全球 · 进一步 · 进展 · 提前 · 恐怕 · 进步 · 对待 · 前往 · 眼前 · 足球 · 全面 · 造 · 前进 · 机器 · 表面 · 作者 · 纪念
body:
前 *front* is the star here (前面, 提前, 前往, 眼前, 前进), with 进 *advance*, 足 *foot, enough*, 造 *make* and 面 *face, surface* each showing up in three or more words.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 前 | qián | front, before | 前面, 提前, 前往, 眼前, 前进 |
| 进 | jìn | advance, enter (辶 walk) | 进一步, 进展, 进步, 前进 |
| 足 | zú | foot; enough | 满足, 足够, 足球 |
| 造 | zào | make, build (辶 walk + 告) | 创造, 制造, 造 |
| 面 | miàn | face, surface, side | 前面, 全面, 表面 |
| 制 | zhì | make, control (刂 knife) | 制造, 制作 |
| 器 | qì | tool, vessel | 武器, 机器 |
| 待 | dài | wait, treat (彳 step) | 等待, 对待 |

## Watch out

- 乐 is **lè** (happy, 快乐) but **yuè** (music, 音乐).
- 怕 appears in both 害怕 (afraid) and 恐怕 (I'm afraid that, probably): the second is a soft "probably".
- 纪 (纟 thread) vs 记 (讠 speech): 世纪, 纪念 use 纪; 记得 uses 记.

cards.Example: 我们输了比赛。 wǒmen shū le bǐsài: We lost the match
cards.Notes: 车 cart + 俞 yú (phonetic) = carry by cart; also lose (a game)

cards.Example: 房间充满阳光。 fángjiān chōngmǎn yángguāng: The room is full of sun
cards.Notes: 充 fill + 满 full (氵 water) = filled to the brim

cards.Example: 苹果皮可以吃。 píngguǒ pí kěyǐ chī: You can eat apple skin
cards.Notes: Picture of a hand (又) peeling hide off. Common as phonetic: 皮 pí in 被, 破, 疲

cards.Example: 人数增加了。 rénshù zēngjiā le: The number of people went up
cards.Notes: 增 add on (土 earth + 曾 céng sound) + 加 add = add more, increase

cards.Example: 下个星期见。 xià ge xīngqī jiàn: See you next week
cards.Notes: 月 moon + 其 qí for the sound = a lunar period, a set time

cards.Example: 那个姑娘很漂亮。 nàge gūniang hěn piàoliang: That girl is pretty
cards.Notes: 姑 aunt (女 + 古 gǔ sound) + 娘 young woman (女 + 良 liáng sound) = girl

cards.Example: 他创造了新纪录。 tā chuàngzào le xīn jìlù: He set a new record
cards.Notes: 创 start, found (刂 knife + 仓 cāng sound) + 造 make = make something new

cards.Example: 麻烦你了，谢谢！ máfan nǐ le, xièxie: Sorry to trouble you, thanks!
cards.Notes: 麻 hemp (tangled fibres) + 烦 annoyed (火 fire + 页 head) = tangled, bothersome

cards.Example: 他们没有武器。 tāmen méiyǒu wǔqì: They have no weapons
cards.Notes: 武 military (止 + 戈 spear) + 器 tool = military tool, weapon

cards.Example: 他的思想很新。 tā de sīxiǎng hěn xīn: His thinking is fresh
cards.Notes: 思 think (田 + 心 heart) + 想 think (相 + 心) = thinking, ideas

cards.Example: 我害怕打针。 wǒ hàipà dǎzhēn: I'm afraid of injections
cards.Notes: 害 harm + 怕 fear (忄 heart + 白 bái sound) = fear harm, afraid

cards.Example: 我属龙。 wǒ shǔ lóng: I was born in the Year of the Dragon
cards.Notes: Simplified from the pictograph 龍 of a dragon. Lookalike: 尤 yóu

cards.Example: 我很满足。 wǒ hěn mǎnzú: I'm content
cards.Notes: 满 full + 足 enough = full and enough, satisfied

cards.Example: 我们在等待消息。 wǒmen zài děngdài xiāoxi: We're waiting for news
cards.Notes: 等 wait + 待 wait (彳 step + 寺 sì sound) = wait

cards.Example: 祝你生日快乐！ zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè: Happy birthday!
cards.Notes: Simplified from 樂, drums on a wooden stand: music (yuè), then joy (lè)

cards.Example: 这个超级好吃！ zhège chāojí hǎochī: This is super tasty!
cards.Notes: 超 surpass (走 walk + 召 zhào sound) + 级 level = above the level, super

cards.Example: 我不吃猪肉。 wǒ bù chī zhūròu: I don't eat pork
cards.Notes: 犭 animal + 者 zhě for the sound. Same 者 as in 都, 猪, 煮

cards.Example: 我们是一个团。 wǒmen shì yí ge tuán: We're one group
cards.Notes: 囗 enclosure + 才, simplified from 團 (專 zhuān for the sound) = round mass; group

cards.Example: 现在是二十一世纪。 xiànzài shì èrshíyī shìjì: It's the 21st century
cards.Notes: 世 generation, era + 纪 record, period (纟 + 己 jǐ sound) = era period, century

cards.Example: 这是中国制造的。 zhè shì Zhōngguó zhìzào de: This is made in China
cards.Notes: 制 make (刂 knife) + 造 make = manufacture

cards.Example: 时间足够了。 shíjiān zúgòu le: There's enough time
cards.Notes: 足 enough + 够 enough (多 many + 句 jù sound) = sufficient

cards.Example: 前面有一家店。 qiánmiàn yǒu yì jiā diàn: There's a shop ahead
cards.Notes: 前 front + 面 face, side = the front side

cards.Example: 这个蛋糕是我制作的。 zhège dàngāo shì wǒ zhìzuò de: I made this cake
cards.Notes: 制 make + 作 do, make = make, produce (films, crafts)

cards.Example: 全球都知道他。 quánqiú dōu zhīdao tā: The whole world knows him
cards.Notes: 全 whole + 球 ball, globe = the whole globe

cards.Example: 我们进一步谈谈。 wǒmen jìnyíbù tántan: Let's discuss further
cards.Notes: 进 advance + 一 one + 步 step = advance one more step. 一 is yí before bù

cards.Example: 有什么进展吗？ yǒu shénme jìnzhǎn ma: Any progress?
cards.Notes: 进 advance + 展 unfold, extend = move forward and unfold

cards.Example: 我提前到了。 wǒ tíqián dào le: I arrived early
cards.Notes: 提 lift (扌 hand) + 前 front = lift to the front, ahead of time

cards.Example: 恐怕要下雨了。 kǒngpà yào xià yǔ le: I'm afraid it'll rain
cards.Notes: 恐 fear (心 heart) + 怕 fear = fearing that, probably

cards.Example: 你的中文进步了！ nǐ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le: Your Chinese has improved!
cards.Notes: 进 advance + 步 step = step forward, improve

cards.Example: 他对待我很好。 tā duìdài wǒ hěn hǎo: He treats me well
cards.Notes: 对 facing + 待 treat = how you face and treat someone

cards.Example: 我们前往机场。 wǒmen qiánwǎng jīchǎng: We're heading to the airport
cards.Notes: 前 forward + 往 go towards (彳 step) = go forward to, head for

cards.Example: 他就在眼前。 tā jiù zài yǎnqián: He's right before my eyes
cards.Notes: 眼 eye + 前 front = in front of the eyes; right now

cards.Example: 我们去踢足球吧。 wǒmen qù tī zúqiú ba: Let's go play football
cards.Notes: 足 foot + 球 ball = foot-ball

cards.Example: 我们要全面了解。 wǒmen yào quánmiàn liǎojiě: We need a full picture
cards.Notes: 全 whole + 面 side, face = every side, all-round

cards.Example: 这座桥是新造的。 zhè zuò qiáo shì xīn zào de: This bridge is newly built
cards.Notes: 辶 walk + 告 gào (phonetic) = make, build

cards.Example: 我们继续前进。 wǒmen jìxù qiánjìn: We keep moving forward
cards.Notes: 前 forward + 进 advance = go forward

cards.Example: 这台机器坏了。 zhè tái jīqì huài le: This machine is broken
cards.Notes: 机 machine (木 wood + 几 jǐ sound) + 器 tool = machine

cards.Example: 表面上他很高兴。 biǎomiàn shang tā hěn gāoxìng: On the surface he's happy
cards.Notes: 表 outside + 面 face = outer face, surface

cards.Example: 这本书的作者是谁？ zhè běn shū de zuòzhě shì shéi: Who's this book's author?
cards.Notes: 作 make, write + 者 person who = the one who wrote it

cards.Example: 这是一个纪念。 zhè shì yí ge jìniàn: This is a keepsake
cards.Notes: 纪 record + 念 remember (今 + 心 heart) = record and remember
